title: Policy Atom
description: A single granular evidence unit extracted from a policy document. Atoms are stored as JSONL — one atom per line — at data/atoms/<source_document_id>.jsonl. This schema validates each atom independently. Atoms are family-agnostic; family-specific shaping happens at the synthesis stage.

atom_id.description: Unique identifier within the document. Convention: <doc_short_id>_a_<NNNN>.

_doc_type.description: Denormalized from the registry for synthesis-stage prioritization. Typical values: parcc, sector_plan, framework, territorial_plan, environmental_program.

_section.description: Section heading the page belongs to per section_map.json. Denormalized for traceability and synthesis-stage filtering.

evidence_text.description: Verbatim excerpt from the source document. Copied character-for-character from the page text. No paraphrase, no translation. The validator confirms this string appears in data/markdown/<id>/document.md for the cited pages.

page_reference.description: Optional human-readable form such as 'p. 12' or 'p. 12-14'.

plain_language_summary.description: One-sentence paraphrase in English. Synthesis-friendly. Distinct from evidence_text which stays in source language.

sector.description: Normalized sector label. Vocabulary in extraction_rules.md.

theme.description: Sub-theme close to source wording. Free text.

action_statement.description: For action atoms: a clean restatement of the named intervention, close to source wording.

target_value_text.description: For target atoms: the target as stated in the source, close to source wording.

raw_value_numeric.description: Parsed numeric value when the atom carries a quantified target, scale, or amount.

timeline.description: Deadline, target year, or implementation period. Close to source.

applicability_scope.description: Plain-language description of where the atom applies.

echoes_atom_id.description: When this atom restates a fact present in another document (e.g. a PARCC restating an NDC target), the atom_id of the upstream atom. Populated by synthesis-stage cross-document linking; optional at extraction time.

notes.description: Free-text reviewer commentary. Not part of the data contract.
